title: pyrus theifera
intro: Pyrus theifera, commonly known as the Wild Pear or Pyrenean Pear, is a species of pear tree native to the Iberian Peninsula and the Pyrenees. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Pyrus theifera is believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic effects, due in part to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus theifera have been shown to have potential health benefits and may contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
